high_level_description: The image depicts a man riding a motorcycle through shallow water at the beach. The man is wearing a dark green jacket, beige pants, black boots, and a black cap with a logo on it. He appears to be carrying a large load of blue plastic bags secured on the back of his motorcycle. The bags have the text "KPU" and "TAHUN 2024" printed on them, indicating they are related to the Indonesian General Election Commission (KPU) for the year 2024. The setting is a sunny day at the beach, with clear blue skies and waves visible in the background.
